{{Quote|I recognize that swagger in your steps. You're an outcast like me. And, like me, you should know that opposition to your aims and goals are grounds for 'removal'. |Andria E'liyha, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AE" />}}
'''Andria E'liyha''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] criminal outcast who lived on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she was planing to eliminate other criminals of the planet in order to become the leader of her own band of outcasts.<ref name="SWG:AE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> she encountered a spacer in [[Nym's Stronghold]] and convinced that adventurer to attack the [[Blood Razors|Blood Razor's]] [[Downed Blood Razor's Transport|camp]] and the [[Droid Engineer's Cave]] in order to, respectively, steal the treasures that were supposedly stocked by the pirates and remove insanity from Lok by killing the [[Sardeya Elgrin|droid engineer]]. She hoped that the elimination of the "opposition" would help her in her project.<ref name="SWG:AE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Andria E'liyha was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Andria E'liyha was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 5 Notes: 16 December 03|Publish 5]]" update, released on [[December 16]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 5: Vehicles">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60892|text=Publish 5: Vehicles}}</ref>
